name: Western Union (1948–1954)
description: A blue field charged with a yellow chain of five links forming a pentagon, within a border of red, yellow, black and white bands.
history: The Western Union (Brussels Treaty Organisation) was the defensive alliance of the United Kingdom, France, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg formed by the Treaty of Brussels in 1948. Its military functions passed to NATO in 1951 and it was reorganised as the Western European Union in 1954.

features.symbolism: the five signatory states linked in mutual defence
